security_audit.summary: The static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and inline resource names in SKILL.md. The network-reconnaissance blocker is also a false positive because line 238 is an audit KPI. I found dual-use security testing guidance that should be bounded to authorized assessment scope.

remediation.issue: Dual-use penetration testing and phishing simulation language
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit authorization, scope, and rules-of-engagement requirements before any security testing guidance.

remediation.issue: References to exploitation frameworks and scanning tools lack usage boundaries
remediation.suggestion: Frame tool use as coordination and evidence review. Prohibit unauthorized testing, credential collection, or activity outside written scope.

remediation.issue: Markdown formatting triggered false command execution detections
remediation.suggestion: Keep diagrams and resource lists clearly formatted as prose. Avoid shell-like examples unless they are necessary and safe.

content.user_title: Assess ISMS Readiness with ISO 27001 Guidance
content.value_statement: ISMS audits require clear scope, evidence, and control testing discipline. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through ISO 27001 audit planning, execution, findings, and reporting.
actual_capabilities: Plans risk-based ISMS audit programs for ISO 27001 and related security requirements.
Structures audit preparation, scope definition, evidence review, and auditor assignment.
Guides security control testing across organizational, technical, physical, and operational controls.
Supports certification, surveillance, and regulatory security inspection preparation.
Defines audit performance metrics and continuous improvement activities.
Coordinates vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and cloud security audit activities.
limitations: Does not replace an accredited ISO 27001 auditor or certification body.
Does not perform live vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, or evidence collection by itself.
Requires organization-specific policies, scope, risks, and control evidence from the user.
Some referenced resource files are listed conceptually and may not be included in the package.

use_cases.title: Build an Internal ISMS Audit Plan
use_cases.description: Create a risk-based audit plan with scope, evidence needs, control areas, and review cadence.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Certification Review
use_cases.description: Organize readiness activities for ISO 27001 Stage 1, Stage 2, and surveillance audits.

use_cases.title: Assess Security Control Evidence
use_cases.description: Review control evidence, identify gaps, and convert observations into audit findings.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Audit Scope
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define an ISO 27001 ISMS audit scope for [organization]. Include assets, processes, controls, evidence, and exclusions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Risk-Based Audit Schedule
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a risk-based ISMS audit schedule for [period]. Use these risk areas, prior findings, incidents, and compliance obligations: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Control Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this control evidence summary against ISO 27001 expectations. Identify gaps, audit questions, required evidence, and risk-based findings: [summary].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Executive Audit Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these ISMS audit observations into an executive report with findings, severity, evidence gaps, risk impact, and remediation priorities: [observations].

output_examples.input: Need an internal ISMS audit plan for cloud access management.
output_examples.output: A scoped audit plan covering cloud identity, privileged access, logging, evidence requests, auditor roles, and review timing.

output_examples.input: We are preparing for ISO 27001 Stage 2 certification.
output_examples.output: A readiness checklist for implemented controls, management review records, internal audit closure, risk treatment evidence, and certification body questions.

output_examples.input: Review our control evidence for backup and recovery.
output_examples.output: A gap-focused assessment with audit questions, missing evidence, control effectiveness concerns, and remediation priorities.

best_practices: Provide the audit scope, risk context, prior findings, and control evidence before asking for findings.
Use the output as audit preparation, then validate conclusions with qualified auditors and evidence owners.
Keep security testing requests inside written authorization, approved scope, and defined rules of engagement.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated audit findings as certification decisions.
Do not request penetration testing, phishing simulation, or scanning without explicit authorization.
Do not share sensitive evidence, credentials, or production secrets in prompts.

faq.question: Does this skill certify ISO 27001 compliance?
faq.answer: No. It supports audit planning and readiness, but certification decisions require an accredited certification body.

faq.question: Can it create an internal audit checklist?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the ISMS scope, control set, risk areas, and evidence sources for a tailored checklist.

faq.question: Can it assess technical security controls?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure control testing questions and evidence review for technical, operational, physical, and organizational controls.

faq.question: Does it run security scans or penetration tests?
faq.answer: No. It can help plan and review authorized testing, but it does not execute tools or collect evidence.

faq.question: What input improves the results?
faq.answer: Provide scope, risk register items, applicable controls, prior findings, incidents, policies, and evidence summaries.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated industries?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for healthcare, financial services, critical infrastructure, cloud, and multi-jurisdictional security audits.
